title: Sphere crash south of the border that killed a cow
place_text: about 100 miles south of the US border near Brownsville, Texas, east coast of Mexico

plain: On a podcast episode about a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people's bodies, a guest named Steve tells a story from a man named Massan. Steve says Massan bought a crashed sphere from a farmer whose land is about 100 miles south of the US border near Brownsville, Texas, on Mexico's east coast, and that the farmer said the crash set off an explosion that killed a cow 100 meters away. The story matters to the tellers because it would mean a physical object from such a crash is in private hands.
